objects.name: Analytic 1936
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a remote service connection between two Industrial Control System (ICS) network hosts that does not match the documented, approved communication matrix, where the destination host subsequently exhibits process execution or file access inconsistent with normal automated/scheduled inter-host communication. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
